document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
You are lost somewhere in the great desert of North Africa. Your water 
will last 1D10 days. If you succeed with a Survival (Desert) roll, add 
1D3 days to that total (you know how to best ration the water). Write 
down the number of days your water will last. Each time you go to 
another entry, subtract a day from your water total. When you run 
out of water, subtract 6 hit points each time you go to another entry. 
Halt the calculation when you reach other humans, or when you die.
You start walking. The heat is incredible, but you must go on! 
Roll 1D10: with a 1 result, go to 213. With 2, 3, or 4 go to 235. 
With 6, 7, 8, or 9 go to 257. With 10, go to 279.
(98, 341, 589)
